name: international-school-fees
description: Published annual tuition for international schools in Dubai, Kuala Lumpur, Singapore and Bangkok, by age and curriculum, with the source and academic year.

interface.longDescription: Compare this year's published tuition at leading international schools in Dubai, Kuala Lumpur, Singapore and Bangkok. Filter by your child's age, curriculum (British, IB, American, French, German) and budget. See one school's full fee table and one-off fees, or the total tuition from your child's current age to the final year. Dubai fees come from the regulator KHDA's fee fact sheets; other cities from each school's own fee page. Every answer shows the academic year and the source. General information only, not personalised advice.
defaultPrompt: What do British schools in Dubai cost for an 11-year-old?
Compare IB school fees in Singapore for a child aged 8.
How much will Garden International School cost in total from age 10 to the final year?
